app.localizedDescription:
Apollo Reborn is the community-maintained Apollo for Reddit sideload build. Current releases require iOS 26 or later and include Liquid Glass and the alternate icon catalog.

Choose Apollo Reborn for widgets and app extensions, or Apollo Reborn No Extensions to omit all app extensions and reduce App ID usage.

Classic appearance, icons-only builds, older iOS and standalone jailbreak packages end on 4.0.x. Those releases remain available in the legacy archive.

For AltStore Classic, SideStore and Feather; not AltStore PAL. This project is not affiliated with Apollo or Christian Selig.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Used to take photos to upload for sharing.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Used to save media or to select images to upload for sharing.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Detect rotations in Media Viewer and offer corresponding options.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Checked once to calculate sunset/sunrise times for the location.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Unlock Apollo when re-opening in order to prevent unauthorized access.

source.name: Apollo Reborn
source.subtitle: iOS 26+ · Widgets and app extensions
source.description: Apollo Reborn for iOS 26 or later. Includes Liquid Glass and alternate icons. Includes widgets and Apollo’s working app extensions. Classic appearance and older iOS remain available in the final 4.0.x releases.

source.name: Apollo Reborn No Extensions
source.subtitle: iOS 26+ · No app extensions
source.description: Apollo Reborn No Extensions for iOS 26 or later. Includes Liquid Glass and alternate icons. Omits all app extensions, including widgets, to reduce App ID usage. Classic appearance and older iOS remain available in the final 4.0.x releases.
